article_fruit_salad.summary: A fruit salad is fruit, cut up and mixed. After reading this you can choose fruits that taste good together, cut fruit safely, make a simple fruit salad at home, and name the colours and vitamins you are eating.
article_fruit_salad.title: Let's Make a Fruit Salad

article_tiny_seed.summary: A small seed falls into the dark soil and waits. Follow it through the rain, the sun and the seasons until it becomes a tree with birds in its branches. After reading, you can retell the story, use its new words, and explain its lesson about patience and care.
article_tiny_seed.title: A Tiny Seed's Big Adventure
